module.label: at module top level
module.guidance: Script code, not an Effect program. If the file is tooling, declare it hostTooling and rescan; otherwise move the statement into a program run at the edge (NodeRuntime.runMain or an executableEdges entry), then rewrite it as below.

function.label: in plain functions
function.guidance: The enclosing function is not Effect code yet. Convert it (Effect.fn / Effect.gen; an async one is reported by EFF002/EFF003) — or, if it is a platform callback, keep it as a terminal adapter that runs an Effect program — then rewrite this hit as below.

effect.label: in Effect programs
effect.guidance: Inside an Effect program: rewrite in place.

boundary.label: in boundary callbacks
boundary.guidance: Inside an Effect.promise/tryPromise/sync/try callback, Promise or synchronous code by design: let the boundary map the failure (catch: (cause) => new XError({ cause })) instead of rewriting the callback body.
